answer: Each identity posts a 75-credit bond at the wharf desk and files a juniper work log with dates and peers. A five-agent panel: each contacts one peer, checks one registry record, and verifies the ivory serial. A reused serial or one log under two names burns the bond; bad-log certifiers lose 20 credits. First fee 36 credits; kth 36+5(k-1) credits, panels never reused, so the 1000th pays 5031 and 1000 fakes pay 2,533,500 plus 75,000 locked bonds. A rented-log ring fails: peers confirm work for the original owner. An honest identity pays 36 once and gets its bond back.
